target.user-input: the graph of a package, derived from the tree and from nothing else: its nodes, its containers and its typed connectors, the same for the same source every time

instruction.user-input: derive a node from each Command and each Literal, a container from each section, block, part and segment, and a connector from each edge of the tree, typed by the operator that wrote it

derive the connectors the tree holds outside its edges: the sequence between siblings, the reference from a literal to the command that binds its name, the result a literal names after a nest, and the call of a template to its definition

requirement.user-input: every node carries the source span of the command it is, so the view and the source point at each other
a diagnostic lands on the node it is about: fix, ask and note, and an empty slot shows as a socket that asks, as needs does in the XML

constraint.user-input: the graph is a function of the tree: it holds no fact the tree does not hold, and where the signed model puts binds and ref in the envelope, they enter the envelope first
what moves an emitted projection moves by decision, written in .decisions, and enters the batch the version moves once for

validate.user-input: for every declared source of the snapshot the graph is derived twice to the same bytes, and the tree is rebuilt from the graph to the same envelope
each connector type of the signed table has a case that shows it, and a tree edge of a kind the table does not name is refused by name, each seen failing before it counts
where the signed model computes the graph in the engine, the Rust answers the same bytes as the JS over the oracle
